list: The official 55 trophies, checked 2026-11-18 against PowerPyx and GTABase, whose lists agree.

trophies.guide: There is no shortcut to this one: it pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all yours. Nothing here is online, there is no difficulty setting to worry about, and no trophy can be missed except possibly Positive Mental Attitude, so the platinum is a straight sum of the rest of the list. Most of the work is the 100% checklist behind A Long Road, which is roughly half of the whole hunt. Play the story first, keep a Chapter 1 save for the balcony meditation, and clean up the checklist and character quests after the credits. Expect around 200 hours from the first mission to the platinum pop.
trophies.hint: The whole game — about 200 hours, difficulty 4/10
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the first mission of Chapter 1, and it unlocks on its own as the story opens, so you cannot miss it and there is nothing to prepare. Play through the opening beats of the mission and the trophy pops when it ends. It is also your first look at how the game teaches its basics — movement, driving and the phone — so take it slowly and pick up the controls rather than rushing. The mission sets up Jason and Lucia's life in Leonida and leads straight into the rest of Chapter 1. If you are starting a fresh save for a trophy run, this is the first trophy on the board.
trophies.hint: Story — unmissable, first hour
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Play through every mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy lands when the first mission of Chapter 2 begins. There is no single thing to do for it beyond finishing the chapter's story, and nothing in the chapter is missable in a way that blocks it. While you are here, do the two things that matter later: meet Cal in Feng Shui so his fishing quests open up, and on the morning after Down to Earth do the balcony meditation with Lucia, then keep a manual save from Chapter 1. Both are covered in the Missables tab. Chapter 1 also introduces the WAiNK app and the world of Leonida, so scan vehicles and study animals as you go.
trophies.hint: Story — unmissable, end of Chapter 1
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish all of Chapter 2 and the trophy pops as Chapter 3 begins, right after Welcome to Vice City. Chapter 2 is where the game opens up properly: both characters are together, the map widens, and several quest lines start that pay off much later, including Kenton's treasure dives and Bret's hunts. Play the story missions in order and take the optional missions as they appear, since some are only offered for a while. The chapter also unlocks the meditation spot that needs Jason and Lucia together, which matters for Positive Mental Attitude. Nothing here can be missed, so just enjoy the story and keep scanning vehicles.
trophies.hint: Story — unmissable, end of Chapter 2
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 3 to the end and the trophy lands after the first two missions of Chapter 4. This chapter is dense with systems that the rest of the hunt depends on: the Key Cloner from Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, the Snap Gun from Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, and the Dye Pack Jammer from Credit Check. Each one unlocks a whole family of trophies — car deliveries, jewellery robberies and marked-bill laundering — so do those missions when they appear and note what they open. Chapter 3 also starts Andy's quest line for Lucia. As with the other chapter trophies, it cannot be missed; finishing the story is enough.
trophies.hint: Story — unmissable, start of Chapter 4
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4 and the trophy pops when the final mission of the chapter ends. Chapter 4 is the longest stretch of the story and holds several named mission trophies of its own — Family Matters, DWNFALL and Hi-Jacked — so by the time this one lands you will have collected a handful of others along the way. Bank vaults also open in this chapter, once you have That's Where The Money Is, so start following security vans and learning the vault routine early. Nothing in Chapter 4 is missable, and free roam continues after the story, so play it at your own pace and keep a save at the chapter's start and end.
trophies.hint: Story — unmissable, end of Chapter 4
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission in Chapter 5 and this gold trophy is yours. It is the last story beat of the game, so there is no way to miss it — play the mission, watch the ending, and the trophy pops as the credits approach. Free roam continues afterwards, so nothing else depends on how you play it: you do not need a particular ending choice, a difficulty setting or a perfect run. The real work starts after this one, when the 100% checklist under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion becomes visible and the long clean-up for A Long Road begins. Save before the final mission if you want to replay the ending later.
trophies.hint: Story — unmissable, the finale
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a story mission in Chapter 2, and the trophy pops when you finish it. It is story-only, so it cannot be missed: play the missions in order and it will come to you. The mission is one of the early ones that shows off the two-character dynamic, with Jason and Lucia working together, and it leads into the wider Chapter 2 content where both characters are available. There is no special preparation, no collectible to grab first and no choice that changes the outcome. Just play the mission through to its end. If you are tracking story trophies in order, this is one of the first named-mission trophies after the chapter trophies.
trophies.hint: Story — unmissable, Chapter 2
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is a story mission in Chapter 3, and the trophy pops when the mission ends. Play the story in order and it arrives on its own — there is nothing to set up, no side requirement and no way to miss it. It is one of the bigger set-piece missions of the middle of the game, so expect a longer mission with a proper plan-and-execute structure rather than a quick errand. Heists like this one are also good practice for the vault and robbery systems that matter later: managing wanted levels, escaping the heat and switching vehicles. Finish the mission, take the payout, and move on to the rest of Chapter 3.
trophies.hint: Story — unmissable, Chapter 3
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Child's Play is a story mission in Chapter 4, and the trophy pops when you complete it. Like every named-mission trophy, it is story-only and cannot be missed: follow the mission markers in order and it will come to you. Chapter 4 holds several of these named missions back to back, so this one is part of a run of story trophies that land as the chapter builds toward its climax. There is no preparation needed and no choice to make — the mission plays out the same way each time. If you are playing for the platinum, just keep the story moving and let these trophies collect themselves.
trophies.hint: Story — unmissable, Chapter 4
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Headliners is a story mission in Chapter 4, and the trophy pops when the mission is complete. It arrives by playing the story in order, with nothing to prepare and nothing that can be missed. The mission's name gives away its flavour — a big, loud set piece in the middle of Chapter 4 — but the trophy itself asks nothing of you beyond finishing it. Chapter 4 is the chapter where the story's named-mission trophies stack up fastest, so expect this one to land close to Family Matters and Hi-Jacked. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter, play the missions through, and the trophy will pop on its own.
trophies.hint: Story — unmissable, Chapter 4
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is a story mission in Chapter 4, and the trophy pops when you finish it. It is story-only and cannot be missed: play the missions in order and it arrives in due course. The mission takes you to the airport, which is worth remembering — VCIA is also where the Catch Me If You Can trophy happens, so while you are learning the airport layout, note the boarding bridges and the gates. There is no special preparation for this trophy itself and no choice that changes it. Finish the mission, and the trophy pops as the chapter pushes toward its final missions.
trophies.hint: Story — unmissable, Chapter 4
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a story mission in Chapter 5, the final chapter, and the trophy pops when the mission ends. Play the story in order and it comes to you — it cannot be missed, and there is nothing to set up in advance. By this point in the game you are near the end of the story, so the mission is one of the last named-mission trophies before the finale and its gold trophy. Expect a large-scale mission with heavy combat, so go in with armour, healing and a good rifle. Finish it, and the road to the final mission is clear.
trophies.hint: Story — unmissable, Chapter 5
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Open the 100% checklist under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion after the story and work through all 35 requirements — the full list is in the Checklist tab of this guide. The checklist only appears after the credits, but everything you do before then already counts, and nothing on it is missable. It is closer to 60% of everything in the game, because most things are only partly required: 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 15 of 18 meditations, 300 of 397 stunts. The biggest chunks are 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 33 underwater discoveries, 42 shooting-range golds and 42 drone races. Expect around 100 hours of clean-up after the story.
trophies.hint: Long grind — about 100 hours after the story
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Land any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Under-bridge flights are the fastest way to rack them up — fly a plane low under the bridges of Leonida and each one counts — while stunt jumps come naturally from ramps and jumps around the map. The 100% checklist wants 300 stunts, not 250, so do not stop when this trophy pops; keep going, because every stunt past 250 still counts toward A Long Road. Track your total in Progress, Stats, and mix stunt types so you are not grinding one kind at the end.
trophies.hint: Grind — a few hours, fastest by plane under bridges
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, the shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), an arcade game, winning a race, and landing a stunt. None of them needs to be done well — one try each is enough — so this is a sampler trophy that pops early if you dip into everything as the map opens up. Check Progress, Activities to see which types you still have left, and knock out the easy ones first: a basket at any hoop, one arcade game at home, one stunt jump. The activity types also feed other trophies, so the time is never wasted. Most players earn it naturally in the first dozen hours.
trophies.hint: Easy — an hour of trying everything once
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Take gold at all 42 shooting-range challenges across the 12 ranges of Leonida. Each range has its own set of challenges, usually timed accuracy and target drills, and gold means beating a set score rather than just finishing. Use the range's own weapons, take your time on the first run to learn the target pattern, then go for speed. Ranges also raise Focus, which helps the Gunslinger trophy, so the practice pays twice. The 100% checklist needs all 42 golds as well, so there is no shortcut — but the ranges stay open after the story, so you can grind them at your own pace in free roam.
trophies.hint: Skill grind — several hours across 12 ranges
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a drone race at each of the 14 Top Fun locations around Leonida. Each location has its own course, and winning means beating the other drones to the finish rather than just completing the course, so learn the racing line and the boost gates before you push hard. The 100% checklist wants all 42 drone races, not just one win per location, so finish every race at each spot while you are there instead of coming back later. Drone races are also good for learning the map from above. If a course gives you trouble, retry it immediately — the races are quick and the locations stay open after the story.
trophies.hint: Moderate — 14 locations, quick races
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 available across Leonida. Repeating the same race does not count, so you need variety: spread your wins across different race types and locations instead of grinding one favourite. Races are found around the map and through the racing scene, and they stay available after the story. Pick races that suit your vehicle — street races in a fast car, off-road in something tougher — and use the racing line to learn each course on the first lap. The 100% checklist wants 30 different race wins, so keep going past 20; every win here counts toward that too.
trophies.hint: Moderate — 20 different wins of 40
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Meet Cal in Feng Shui, a Chapter 1 mission, and he will start sending you fishing quests — watch for his texts marking purple fishing spots on the map. Follow his quests when they come in, learn the fishing controls at each spot, and keep at it until he challenges you directly. Beat him in his fishing challenge and the trophy pops. Fishing is slow and patient by design: match the right bait to the spot, watch the line tension, and do not rush the reel. Cal's quests also count toward the activity types for Master of None, so this is one of the first side quest lines worth starting early in Chapter 1.
trophies.hint: Easy — follow Cal's texts from Chapter 1
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game end to end. Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home, while Bang For Your Buck is on arcade cabinets around Leonida. Pick the one you enjoy most — they are short, self-contained games inside the game — and play it through to its ending rather than just starting it. Arcade games also count as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None, and the 100% checklist wants all 4 video games played, so try the others afterwards too. If a game beats you, it restarts quickly, and there is no penalty for retrying as many times as you like.
trophies.hint: Easy — one full playthrough of any arcade game
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Lucia only. In Chapter 3 Andy calls, then texts an address in Belville, and his quest line opens. Do his five quests in order — Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops when the last one ends. The quests are spread out, so do them as they arrive rather than hunting for them all at once. Andy is one of the character quest-givers whose line also feeds the Strangers & Freaks strand count in spirit, though his line is a named trophy of its own. The line is still available after the story, so there is no rush and nothing to miss.
trophies.hint: Lucia only — five quests, still open after the story
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton marks treasure dives with purple chest icons after Island Dreams in Chapter 1. Dive at the markers, use the metal detector to dig up each chest, and bring the haul back to him. Clear all 7 shipwrecks and the trophy pops when the final mission ends. Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 and texts again later, so do not worry if he disappears for a while — it is not missable, and his line stays open after the story. The dives also feed the 100% checklist, which needs 33 underwater discoveries, so the treasure hunting does double duty. Bring a boat, dive gear and patience: the chests are spread across the coast.
trophies.hint: Seven shipwrecks — Kenton goes quiet, then returns
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, head to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County and Billy's quest line opens. Do his five jobs in order, ending with Hometown Heroes, and the trophy pops when the last job is done. The jobs are mud-racing and backwoods chaos, so bring a tough off-road vehicle and expect a mess. Billy's line is one of the character quest lines that the roadmap's Stage 3 clean-up covers, and it stays available after the story, so there is no way to miss it. Do the jobs as they appear and the trophy will land in the natural course of the clean-up.
trophies.hint: Five jobs at the Thrillbilly Mudclub, after the story too
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger strands that count toward the trophy: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed as counting, while Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count, even though they have their own quest lines and trophies. Watch the trophy's own progress counter to see which strands are registering, and do not waste time finishing a line that does not count for this one. Stranger missions appear as question marks and encounters around Leonida, and none of them are needed for 100% completion, so this is a clean-up trophy for after the story. Work through the confirmed four first, then the remaining strands the counter accepts.
trophies.hint: Moderate — 8 counting strands, check the counter
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: After Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS in Chapter 3 you get the Key Cloner, and Randy's line opens. Deliver the 16 sports cars on Randy's Wish List to his garage in west Vice City, and the trophy pops when the last car is delivered. Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check them against the list before you steal one — the app tells you what you are looking at, which saves a lot of wasted trips. Hotel driveways around Vice Beach are good hunting grounds for the expensive cars on the list. The line stays open after the story, so deliver cars as you find them and the trophy will land in due course.
trophies.hint: 16 sports cars — scan with WAiNK first
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason only. After Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, Tyrone's line opens: destroy the purple-marked synthetic labs around Vice City until his last job, Shut Down the Labs, appears. Work through the labs one by one — they are marked on the map, so there is no hunting in the dark — and finish the final job to pop the trophy. The labs are guarded, so go in armed and armoured, and expect a fight at each one. Tyrone's line is one of the character quest lines in the Stage 3 clean-up, and it stays available after the story, so there is no way to miss it.
trophies.hint: Jason only — destroy the marked labs, then the finale
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations; a spot done with Jason and Lucia together counts twice. The last spot needs them together, and that only opens after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Now the catch, and the reason this is the only possibly-missable trophy: the morning after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. That meditation adds plus one to the counter but is not marked as a Meditation Spot, and it is unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it. Do it anyway — and keep a Chapter 1 save. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18, so it cannot cost you A Long Road.
trophies.hint: Possibly missable — do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Jason only. After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, Bret texts you, and his hunting line opens — start with Veteran Hunted in Lummox County, then hunt the animals on his purple-marked Target Decks and bring them back. Which animal pops the trophy is still unconfirmed: the sources do not agree on the exact trigger, so the honest guidance is to work through Bret's decks in order and the trophy should land as you go. The 100% checklist needs all 15 Target Decks anyway, so every hunt counts twice. A clean one-shot kill pays more, but it is not required for the trophy. Keep the line going after the story if it has not popped yet.
trophies.hint: Unconfirmed which animal pops it — work the decks
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets — 480 cards in total across Leonida. Cards are tucked into shops, houses, vehicles and hidden corners, and Progress, Collections shows each set and what you still need, so use it as your shopping list rather than wandering blind. Pick the three smallest or most convenient sets first and finish them before moving on, since a half-finished set earns nothing. The 100% checklist needs 15 of the 18 sets, so this trophy is only the beginning of a long card hunt. Cards stay available after the story, so there is no rush and nothing to miss.
trophies.hint: Long collectible hunt — 3 sets first, 15 for 100%
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan any 100 WAiNK spots with the phone app — hold Up, then R1 or RB, and point it at a landmark. There are 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags to find, and the app tells you when a scan registers. The 100% checklist needs exactly 100 WAiNK scans as well, so this trophy and that checklist item are the same work. Make it a habit: scan something new every time you pass a landmark, a statue or a strange sight, rather than grinding it all at the end. Scanning vehicles with the same app counts toward Whip It Good and the vehicle checklist, so the app earns its keep across the whole hunt.
trophies.hint: Habit trophy — scan as you travel, 100 spots
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges in the game. Challenges are small feats across combat, driving, exploration and activities — Progress, Challenges ticks finished ones off, so check it to see what is close to done and finish those first. The 100% checklist needs 70 of the 80, so this trophy comes along the way and you should keep going past 50 rather than stopping. Many challenges complete themselves during normal play, especially the driving and combat ones, so do not force them early. After the story, work through the list deliberately, starting with the ones you are already halfway through.
trophies.hint: Comes naturally — 50 of 80, 70 needed for 100%
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Once both characters are together, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, call your partner, build a 4-star wanted level and escape the red heat zone — not just the flashing search area, but the whole zone, until the wanted level clears. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a good escape route: it shakes off cops and helicopters alike. Bank vault robberies always give 4 stars, so this often pops while you are doing Maximum Withdrawal anyway. Go in with a fast vehicle, keep moving, and do not stop to fight — the trophy is about escaping, not winning a shootout.
trophies.hint: Needs your partner — escape the red heat zone fully
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, rob 3 shops in a row while still wanted — the flashing red and blue must stay up across all three robberies, so do not let the heat die between shops. Go in armoured, with sticky bombs and healing, and pick shops close together: the 3 jewellery stores in north Vice City are near each other, which keeps the travel time down. It can take about 30 seconds to pop after the third shop, so do not panic if it does not trigger instantly; if it still has not popped, rob a fourth shop while still wanted. Plan the route before the first robbery and keep moving.
trophies.hint: Tricky — 3 shops in a row, stay wanted throughout
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Scan 100 different vehicles with the WAiNK app — you do not need to drive them, just point the app at them and let it register. Stand by a busy road and scan passing traffic, and the count climbs fast; variety matters, so move around the map rather than scanning the same cars. The 100% checklist needs 200 base models, so keep scanning past 100 — every new model counts toward that bigger target too. Boats and aircraft count as well, so scan those when you see them. This is one of the easiest trophies in the game if you make scanning a habit from the first chapter onward.
trophies.hint: Easy — scan traffic, 100 models, 200 for 100%
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop 5 enemies in one Combat Focus — click both sticks while aiming to trigger it — and the trophy pops. Fill your Focus first: eat, drink and wash up to top it off, and Adrenaline stretches it further, giving you more time to line up kills. Use an assault rifle for the range and rate of fire, and pick gang-operation thugs as your targets, because cops, soldiers and civilians do not seem to count toward the five. Set up in a gang operation with plenty of enemies in the open, trigger Focus, and work through them quickly. If you run out of time, refill Focus and try again.
trophies.hint: Combat — fill Focus, use a rifle, target gang thugs
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At VCIA, the airport, steal a big passenger jet docked at a boarding bridge — not one parked out on the airfield — and take off with it. Gates E3 and E4 are the easiest: drive through the airfield fence, use the door by the stairs, back the jet out, take off and fly about 1 kilometre from the airport. The jet is heavy and slow to turn, so give yourself plenty of runway and climb steadily rather than banking hard. Expect a wanted level on the way in, so go in fast and do not stop to fight. Once you are a kilometre clear, the trophy pops.
trophies.hint: Airport — steal a jet at a gate, fly 1 km clear
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank from Mile Zero Air Station on the south-west island of Mariana County — the tanks are at the south end of the base — and shoot enemies from inside it until the trophy pops. The base is guarded, so go in fast, grab a tank and drive out before the response builds up. Once you are in the tank, you are heavily armoured, so find a spot with enemies in range and use the cannon. You do not need to destroy anything specific; shooting enemies from inside the tank is what counts. Expect a big wanted level, but the tank can take it — just keep moving and keep firing.
trophies.hint: Military base — steal a Rhino, shoot from inside
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: After Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 you have the Snap Gun, and that is the key to this one. Use it on a jewellery store's locked back door — kicking the door in trips the alarm — then find the safe code in the back room and empty the safe unseen. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds works well for this. Move slowly, watch the staff and the cameras, and leave the way you came in. If you are spotted, the attempt is blown, so leave, lose the heat and try again rather than fighting it out. Patience beats speed here; a clean, quiet robbery is the whole trophy.
trophies.hint: Stealth — Snap Gun on the back door, don't trip the alarm
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Bank vaults open with That's Where The Money Is in Chapter 4. Follow a security van to its bank, slip in while the vault is open, and hand a bag to your partner — one person cannot carry it all, so your partner has to be with you. Vaults always give 4 stars, so plan the escape before you go in: leave on a fast bike, then switch vehicles to break the line of sight. Any 5 of the 8 vaults count for this trophy, but the 100% checklist needs all 8, so learn the routine and repeat it. Robbing a vault also counts toward the armoured truck trophy and the Hot Together escape.
trophies.hint: Heist — 5 of 8 vaults, bring your partner, plan the escape
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armoured truck and escape, and the trophy pops. The direct way is to box in a truck on the road, stick a bomb on its back doors, blow them open and get away with the cash. But note that robbing a bank vault counts too, as long as you escape the heat zone or reach a Pay 'n' Spray afterwards — so if you are already doing Maximum Withdrawal, this one may pop on its own. Either way, the escape matters as much as the robbery: get clear of the heat zone before you slow down. A fast car, a planned route and a Pay 'n' Spray on the way out make both methods much easier.
trophies.hint: Easy — bomb the back doors, or let a vault robbery count
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Unfog the whole map of Leonida — every dark patch on the map has to be visited. A plane is the fastest way to do it: fly over every dark patch until nothing is left, sweeping the map in a grid so you do not miss a corner. The islands and the far corners of Kelly County and Mariana County are the ones people miss, so check the map after each sweep and fly over anything still dark. There is no combat or collectible involved, just coverage, so this is a relaxing trophy to do while listening to the radio. It pairs well with stunt flying, since low passes under bridges count toward Cunning Stunts at the same time.
trophies.hint: Exploration — fly a plane over every dark patch
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation — the yellow icons on the map — from each of the 9 gangs in Leonida, and the trophy pops. Progress, Gangs keeps count of which gangs you have hit, so check it before you start and target the gangs you are missing rather than repeating ones you have already robbed. Gang operations are also the backbone of the 100% checklist, which needs all 39 of them, so every robbery here counts twice. Go in armed and armoured, loot everything including the backroom safes, and expect a fight. After the story, the operations stay open, so you can finish the set at your own pace.
trophies.hint: One operation per gang — 9 gangs, 39 for 100%
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach, and the trophy should pop. The honest catch is that the exact steps are unconfirmed — GTABase lists this trophy as not yet confirmed, so no source can tell you with certainty which bar or which seat triggers it. The best guidance is to go to Ocean Beach, find a bar or cafe with a seafront view, order a cocktail and sit with the view for a while; try a few different spots along the beach if the first one does not trigger it. Do not grind it — try it when passing through the area anyway.
trophies.hint: Unconfirmed exact steps — try a beachfront bar
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight out through the window. You need the Key Cloner from Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS in Chapter 3 first, or you cannot take the car at all. GTABase notes the exact steps are not yet confirmed, while PowerPyx names this Banshee method, so this guide follows PowerPyx's version and flags the uncertainty honestly. Line the car up at the window, build a little speed inside the showroom and drive through the glass in one go. If it does not pop, try again — the showroom and the car reset, and there is nothing to lose by retrying.
trophies.hint: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx names the blue Banshee method
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: At Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — the alley marked by Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2 — take all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the north-east table, and the safe in the north-east hallway, for which you should bring sticky bombs. It pops once you lose the police afterwards, so plan your escape before you go in. You do not need all 3 valuables in one visit, which takes the pressure off: grab what you can, get out, and come back for the rest later. The alley stays open after the story, so this is a clean-up trophy you can finish whenever you are in the area.
trophies.hint: Three valuables at Kingpin Bowling — escape the police after
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Max out Strength for Jason and Lucia at the same time, and the trophy pops. Work out at fitness clubs together — training one trains the other, so you are building both characters with every session — or work out at home after the story if you prefer privacy. Strength builds slowly, so treat this as a background goal: do a workout whenever you are passing a gym rather than grinding it in one sitting. The two characters share the grind, which makes it much faster than maxing one alone. Check each character's stats to see how close you are, and keep the sessions regular until both bars are full.
trophies.hint: Both characters at once — train together at the gym
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile, and the trophy pops. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings, UI, so you can watch the count climb as you play — every crime, every choice and every shady action feeds it. Most players get this one without trying, just by playing the story and the side content normally, because 500 sounds like a lot and the game hands them out constantly. Do not push to Irredeemable on purpose: the Irredeemable profile is permanent and locks you out of the other profiles, so play normally and let the count build. If you are close to 500 late in the game, small crimes in free roam will finish it.
trophies.hint: Passive — 500 profile actions, don't chase Irredeemable
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: The description is deliberately vague — second time's the charm — and the exact steps are unconfirmed. PowerPyx believes this trophy is tied to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue, but that is not confirmed by both sources, so this guide will not pretend otherwise. The honest advice is to play the Prologue carefully, visit the Payday Loans store, and interact with what is there; if the trophy is tied to that store, a second visit or a second interaction is the likely trigger. If it does not pop there, check back when the community confirms the method.
trophies.hint: Unconfirmed — believed tied to the Prologue Payday Loans store
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: The description gives nothing away — what the hell just happened — and the exact steps are unconfirmed. PowerPyx believes this trophy is tied to a UFO questline, but that is not confirmed, so this guide will not invent a step-by-step for it. The honest guidance is to keep an eye out for strange events and UFO-related content as you explore Leonida, especially at night and in the more remote parts of the map, and to follow any questline that starts feeling otherworldly. Strange events are the kind of thing the community pins down quickly after release, so check the sources named on this trophy when you are hunting it, and do not waste hours guessing.
trophies.hint: Unconfirmed — believed tied to a UFO questline
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock people down with a melee attack from a vehicle — a melee drive-by — and the trophy pops. The exact steps are unconfirmed, and PowerPyx believes it is kicking enemies while riding a motorcycle, so that is the method this guide recommends: get on a motorcycle, ride at a pedestrian or an enemy, and kick out at them as you pass. It may take a few attempts to land the hit at speed, so pick a straight road with people on it and make several passes. If the motorcycle kick does not trigger it, try melee attacks from other vehicles as well.
trophies.hint: Unconfirmed — believed to be a kick from a motorcycle
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: After Credit Check in Chapter 3 you have the Dye Pack Jammer, and marked bills start flowing. Rob banks and Payday Loans, then sell the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays best, so make him your regular. It is a running total, not a single haul, so every robbery adds to it and the 100% checklist's bank and payday jobs get you most of the way there. One large bank can pay out over $200,000 in marked bills on its own, so a handful of big jobs is enough. Keep the jammer on, fence after every job, and the trophy pops well before you finish the robbery checklist.
trophies.hint: Running total — fence marked bills, Yasmani pays best
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across every kind of shop in Leonida — a running total, so it all adds up. Guns, car mods and tattoos burn through it fastest, so if you want to finish it quickly, kit out a favourite car or buy a serious weapon loadout. But most players earn this one without trying, just by playing normally: ammo, clothes, food, car repairs and upgrades all count, and $100,000 is not much by the middle of the game. There is no need to waste money on things you do not want — spend it on gear you will actually use, and the trophy will pop in the natural course of a playthrough.
trophies.hint: Passive — guns, car mods and tattoos burn it fastest
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy the 8 garages for sale in the Vice City Real Estate phone app, after Daily Driver in Chapter 2, for about $160,000 in total. The 4 garages the story gives you do not count, so you need the 8 bought ones specifically — check the app to see which ones you own and which are still for sale. Garages are useful as well as collectible: they store your cars, so buy them as you can afford them rather than all at once. Money comes fast from robberies and fence sales in the middle of the game, so $160,000 is very reachable. Buy the last one and the trophy pops.
trophies.hint: Eight bought garages, about $160,000 — story garages don't count
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: After Moses' Chapter 2 mission you have the Scooter Bros app. Take stolen vehicles to his Port Gellhorn garage, respray and register them, and the trophy pops at 10 registered vehicles. At first he only takes cars without trackers, so start with cheap, untracked cars; from Chapter 3 any Pay 'n' Spray registers tracked ones too, which opens up the whole map. Use cheap cars and keep garage space free — you do not need to register anything expensive, and a registered car you do not want is just taking up a slot. Ten quick registrations is all it takes, and the app is a handy way to make stolen cars yours.
trophies.hint: Ten cheap cars — untracked first, any car from Chapter 3
trophies.name: On the Spot

xbox: Same 55 achievements on Xbox Series X|S, 1,000 Gamerscore in total; the platinum is a 0G Mythic achievement on Xbox.
